candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old and has had cough or difficult breathing for 3 days. The child is calm during assessment. Convulsions are not present now and there has been no history of convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious, is able to drink or breastfeed, and does not vomit everything. There is no diarrhoea, ear problem, or fever. Breaths were counted over one minute, with a respiratory rate of 35 breaths per minute. Chest indrawing is present. There is no stridor when calm, and wheezing or recurrent wheeze are not present. HIV exposure or infection is confirmed, and a pulse oximeter is not available.
